priorityList: Cast Multi-Shot if Trick Shots is not active to trigger the buff for your next Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire.
Cast Multi-Shot to spend Precise Shots stacks.
Activate Trueshot as your primary offensive cooldown, ideally when Volley is available.
Cast Volley on cooldown to maintain Trick Shots and deal burst damage.
Cast Aimed Shot whenever Trick Shots is active and you have charges.
Cast Rapid Fire whenever Trick Shots is active.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities during Trueshot for maximum benefit.
Cast Steady Shot if you are low on Focus and have no other priority abilities available.
